delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONSIDERATION. The receiving party shall protect disclosed information for a period of three years and any financial contribution explored shall not exceed thirty-two million dollars. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
